name: novaforge-frontend
description: NovaForge frontend workspace (PHASE-2 §2): runtime-ui, builder-ui, and the shared package (page model, expression twin, component catalog, resolver, renderer, gateway client).

scripts.package: pnpm -r --no-bail build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist/runtime',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist/builder',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('runtime-ui/dist','dist/runtime',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('builder-ui/dist','dist/builder',{recursive:true});console.log('assembled dist/runtime + dist/builder — mount at /static for the gateway')"
